name: Bank of Maharashtra
business_summary: Pune-headquartered public-sector bank (government holds 73.6%) with a strong retail/MSME and CASA franchise; one of the best-performing PSU banks by RoA/RoE (ROE 22.6%). Q2 FY27 PAT Rs 2,310 cr (+41% y/y), NII +22%, total business +25.16%, asset quality improved. Stock +44% over 12m, market cap Rs 64.6k cr, P/E 8.1x, P/B 1.7x. Government is the main shareholder; FIIs 6.5% and DIIs 13.8%.

cost_structure.note: interest expense Rs 16.9k cr TTM of Rs 31.7k cr revenue

exposures.mechanism: Total business +25.16% in Q2 (Indian Masterminds), NII +22%; PSU bank with leverage to loan growth; +3pp system credit growth -> advances +3.5pp -> NII +4% -> PPOP +5%; persistence 0.7 -> +3.5.

evidence.note: Q2 FY27 PAT Rs 2,310 cr (+41%), NII +22%, total business +25.16%, asset quality improved (CNBC TV18/Fortune India/Indian Masterminds)

exposures.mechanism: Low-cost CASA franchise (~50%+, model knowledge); +3pp deposit growth eases funding for 25% book growth; FCNR(B) inflows are a double-edged margin factor.

evidence.note: FCNR(B) inflows boost deposits but are a margin drag (ET BFSI)

exposures.mechanism: +25bp: ~55-60% of loans are EBLR/repo-linked and reprice in one quarter; deposits reprice over ~12m with CASA sticky. Gross NII +Rs 400 cr/yr first year vs deposit repricing -Rs 250 cr -> net +Rs 150 cr = +1.5% PBT; persistence 0.7 -> ~+1.0; adds momentum for PSU-bank NIM, +1.5 rounded (MS lists PNB/Axis as winners, NDTV Profit 7 Oct).

Investment book ~Rs 1.2 lakh cr (30% of assets, model knowledge), AFS/FVTPL ~25% at modified duration ~2.5: +25bp = -0.6% -> ~Rs 190 cr = -1.9% PBT; RBI interest rate fluctuation reserve cushions; also discount-rate effect: -1.5.

Gross NPA ~1.6%, net NPA ~0.2% (model knowledge); credit cost ~0.4%. +50bp on advances ~Rs 2.7 lakh cr = Rs 1,350 cr = -13% of annual PBT (~Rs 10k cr); persistence 0.55 -> -7. Q2 asset quality improved.

evidence.note: Q2 FY27 PAT Rs 2,310 cr (+41%), NII +22%, total business +25.16%, asset quality improved (CNBC TV18/Fortune India/Indian Masterminds)

exposures.mechanism: Retail unsecured is a small slice; PSU focus on MSME/agri/housing: -0.5.
Government/PSU borrowers and infrastructure credit; +10% capex growth -> corporate credit demand +2pp; also state-government exposure: +1.5.
Draft ECL provisioning (stage-wise, effective FY28 - model knowledge) and project-finance norms raise provisions; PSU banks with low coverage most exposed; -2.
FII holding rising 5.55% -> 6.50%; 73.6% govt; thin float and mid-cap PSU beta 1.1-1.2 magnify flows: +2.5.
MF buying for 4 straight quarters (ET 29 Sep); DII 13.76%; +10% flows -> +2.

evidence.note: MF buying for 4 straight quarters (Economic Times)

exposures.mechanism: +1pp GDP -> loans +1.5pp, credit cost -5bp -> PBT +5% x persistence 0.6 -> +3.
+5 VIX pts -> Nifty ~-3.5%; PSU bank beta 1.1-1.2 + 36% vol, stock +44% in 12m so profit-taking risk: -3.5.
PSU bank FDI/privatisation liberalisation chatter lifts valuations of smaller PSU banks; the Bank-of-Maharashtra 73.6% govt stake leaves headroom for MPS-led sell-downs (supply risk); net +0.5.
